page_title: MAL 2-2 OSA | Mallorca v Osasuna 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Jesus Manzano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+5' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Osasuna players have a reason to celebrate!
90+3' The Osasuna players halt their celebrations as referee Jesus Manzano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90+2' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Lucas Torro laid the ball off to Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
86' Alessio Lisci (Osasuna) gets a yellow card, off the field.
85' Today's referee Jesus Manzano rightly decides to book Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) for his harsh tackle.
83' Substitution. Sheraldo Becker (Osasuna) has come on for Jon Moncayola.
83' Alessio Lisci decides to make a substitution. Abel Bretones will be replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).

82' 2 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Raul Garcia (Osasuna) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Lucas Bergstrom just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 2:1.
81' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Samu Costa (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Takuma Asano (Mallorca) coming on for Jan Virgili.
81' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Torre (Mallorca) replacing Sergi Darder.
79' Mallorca get a corner.
76' Substitution. Victor Munoz leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kike Barja (Osasuna).
74' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) will deliver the corner kick.
71' Alessio Lisci has decided to make a change. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) replaces Asier Osambela.
71' Substitution. Ante Budimir did his best and is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
70' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) took the corner.
69' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
66' 2 - 0 Goal! Jan Virgili slips it to Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 2:0.
65' Here's the change. Mateo Joseph leaves the pitch and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
62' 1 - 0 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Sergio Herrera.
61' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' One of the Osasuna players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. The referee makes a quick call and points to the penalty spot. Big scoring opportunity for Mallorca.
59' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) is booked.
57' The free kick is taken by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), but ball is cleared.

56' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Sergio Herrera!
54' A pass from Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is intercepted by Lucas Bergstrom and the move breaks down.
51' The referee awards a corner and Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) goes over to take it.
50' The linesman makes the right call and Osasuna will have a corner.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Osasuna.
47' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Abel Bretones (Osasuna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) attempts to discuss the decision with Jesus Manzano, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
41' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
41' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Jesus Manzano's book.
41' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
40' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) outjumps his marker on the edge of the 6-yard box and heads the resulting corner well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
39' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner.
37' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

36' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
35' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Jesus Manzano stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Osasuna in a dangerous position.

34' Samu Costa (Mallorca) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
33' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game. One of the players from Osasuna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
31' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Asier Osambela (Osasuna) was too aggressive in his challenge.
27' The possession of the ball – 66:34.
26' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball has crossed the sideline. Osasuna are taking a throw-in.
25' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
23' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
22' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
21' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).

21' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
19' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
18' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Bergstrom intercepts the ball.
18' Osasuna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
15' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
13' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
10' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) sends an accurate short pass. Antonio Raillo controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
8' Mallorca keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
7' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
6' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
6' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
6' The ball is cleared after Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.

4' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jesus Manzano with no other option than to blow for a foul.
3' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
2' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Osasuna have a corner.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
